notes: Style v2 pale iris landmarks on slate mineral roots (round 6, 2026-10-31). Four distinct silhouettes: aqua_a a dark column with a light-facing chisel cut, violet_a a left-leaning spear before a broad unlit back shard, aqua_b a lit crystal toppled across a dark upright one, violet_b a squat crown. Each has one broad lit plane broken by a fracture, a larger unlit mass, small emissive tip caps (at least 5 within 18 px of the anchor column, which the lighting bake needs to add the crystal source) and a slate root overlapping every base. Upper-left light, so these read best unflipped. Legacy aqua/violet animation names, 48x64 cells, 24,61 anchor, footprints and light metadata preserved. Alpha is binary and a transparent margin prevents clipping or wrapped pixels. Rebuild with tools/glasswater/v2style.py (facet plans in tools/glasswater/landmarks.py).
